title: N57: Sector ETF gamma validation — 11/11 correct, Financials strongest (consistent with Black 1976)
description: Tested gamma-based model selection on 11 SPDR sector ETFs (2024-2025 OOS). All 11 have positive significant gamma (t>1.65), rule predicts GJR for all, correct for all (100%). Financials (XLF) has strongest gamma=0.264 (consistent with Black 1976 capital structure mechanism — highest financial leverage), Energy (XLE) weakest gamma=0.076 (supply-side dynamics dilute equity leverage).
